startingCard.title: George V becomes king of the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland
startingCard.fact: George V was King of the United Kingdom and the British Dominions, and Emperor of India, from 6 May 1910 until his death in 1936.

cards.title: George Grenville becomes prime minister of the United Kingdom
cards.fact: George Grenville was a British Whig statesman who served as Prime Minister of Great Britain, during the early reign of the young George III.

cards.title: ‘And Then There Were None’ is published
cards.subtitle: Book by Agatha Christie
cards.fact: And Then There Were None is a mystery novel by the English writer Agatha Christie, who described it as the most difficult of her books to write.

cards.title: ‘Resident Evil’ releases
cards.subtitle: Video game by Capcom
cards.fact: Resident Evil is a 1996 survival horror video game developed and published by Capcom for the PlayStation.

cards.title: ‘The Dark Side of the Moon’ is released
cards.subtitle: Album by Pink Floyd
cards.fact: The Dark Side of the Moon is the eighth studio album by the English progressive rock band Pink Floyd, released on 1 March 1973 by Capitol Records in the US and on 16 March 1973 by Harvest Records in the UK.

cards.title: Boeing C-17 Globemaster III first flies
cards.subtitle: Aircraft by Boeing
cards.fact: The McDonnell Douglas/Boeing C-17 Globemaster III is a large military transport aircraft developed for the United States Air Force (USAF) during the 1980s and the early 1990s by McDonnell Douglas.

cards.title: Miami Marlins is founded
cards.subtitle: MLB franchise
cards.fact: The Miami Marlins are an American professional baseball team based in Miami.

cards.title: ‘Anaconda’ is released
cards.subtitle: Film directed by Luis Llosa
cards.fact: Anaconda is a 1997 action adventure horror film directed by Luis Llosa and written by Hans Bauer, Jim Cash and Jack Epps Jr..

cards.title: ‘Mario Party 9’ releases
cards.subtitle: Video game by Nintendo Cube
cards.fact: Mario Party 9 is a 2012 party video game developed by NDcube and published by Nintendo for the Wii.

cards.title: Nellie Bly dies
cards.subtitle: American journalist
cards.fact: Elizabeth Cochrane Seaman, better known by her pen name Nellie Bly, was an American journalist who was widely known for her record-breaking trip around the world in 72 days in emulation of Jules Verne's fictional character Phileas Fogg, and for an exposé in which she worked undercover to report on a mental institution from within.

cards.title: ‘When We All Fall Asleep, Where Do We Go?’ is released
cards.subtitle: Album by Billie Eilish
cards.fact: When We All Fall Asleep, Where Do We Go?

cards.title: ‘La Belle Jardinière’ is painted
cards.subtitle: Painting by Raphael
cards.fact: La Belle Jardinière, also known as the Madonna and Child with Saint John the Baptist, is a painting started by the Italian High Renaissance artist Raphael, and finished by Ridolfo del Ghirlandaio, that depicts the Madonna, a young Christ, and a young John the Baptist.

cards.title: Charlie Chaplin dies
cards.subtitle: English comic actor and filmmaker
cards.fact: Sir Charles Spencer Chaplin Jr. was an English comic actor, filmmaker, film editor and composer who rose to fame in the era of silent film.

cards.title: ‘The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time’ releases
cards.subtitle: Video game by Nintendo Entertainment Analysis & Development
cards.fact: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time is a 1998 action-adventure game developed and published by Nintendo for the Nintendo 64.

cards.title: Fattah-1 enters service
cards.subtitle: Iranian hypersonic ballistic missile
cards.fact: Fattah-1 is an Iranian medium-range ballistic missile developed by the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps and unveiled in June 2023.

cards.title: ‘The Boys’ airs for the first time
cards.subtitle: American television series
cards.fact: The Boys is an American satirical superhero television series developed by Eric Kripke for Amazon Prime Video.

cards.title: Stari Most is completed
cards.subtitle: Bridge in Mostar over the river Neretva
cards.fact: The Old Bridge, also known as the Mostar Bridge, is a rebuilt 16th-century Ottoman bridge in the city of Mostar in Bosnia and Herzegovina.

cards.title: Malcolm Fraser becomes prime minister of Australia
cards.fact: John Malcolm Fraser was an Australian farmer and politician who was the 22nd prime minister of Australia, serving from 1975 to 1983.

cards.title: ‘Rust in Peace’ is released
cards.subtitle: Album by Megadeth
cards.fact: Rust in Peace is the fourth studio album by American thrash metal band Megadeth, released on September 24, 1990, by Capitol Records.

cards.title: Vickers Viscount first flies
cards.subtitle: Aircraft by Vickers
cards.fact: The Vickers Viscount is a retired British medium-range turboprop airliner first flown in 1948 by Vickers-Armstrongs.

cards.title: La Jument is completed
cards.subtitle: Lighthouse in Finistère, France
cards.fact: La Jument is a lighthouse in Brittany, Northwestern France.

cards.title: ‘TV Time’ launches
cards.subtitle: Mobile app
cards.fact: TV Time is a tracking platform and social television network for TV and movies, available in app and desktop forms.

cards.title: Kenilworth Castle is completed
cards.subtitle: Castle ruin in the town of Kenilworth, Warwickshire, England, UK
cards.fact: Kenilworth Castle is a castle in the town of Kenilworth in Warwickshire, England, managed by English Heritage; much of it is in ruins.

cards.title: Faxian dies
cards.fact: Faxian, formerly romanized as Fa-hien, Fa-hsien, and Hiuen Tsang was a Chinese Buddhist monk and translator who traveled on foot from Jin China to medieval India to acquire Buddhist scriptures.

cards.title: F-86 Sabre first flies
cards.subtitle: Aircraft by Canadair
cards.fact: The North American F-86 Sabre, sometimes called the Sabrejet, is a transonic jet powered fighter aircraft.

cards.title: Mikhaylovsky Palace is completed
cards.subtitle: Palace in Saint Petersburg, Russia
cards.fact: The Mikhailovsky Palace is a grand ducal palace in Saint Petersburg, Russia.

cards.title: Xia dynasty is established
cards.subtitle: Historical state
cards.fact: The Xia dynasty is the first dynasty in traditional Chinese historiography.

cards.title: ‘The Sopranos’ airs for the first time
cards.subtitle: American crime drama television series
cards.fact: The Sopranos is an American crime drama television series created by David Chase.

cards.title: ‘Disney XD’ launches
cards.subtitle: TV channel
cards.fact: Disney XD is an American pay television channel owned by the Disney Branded Television and Disney Entertainment units of The Walt Disney Company.

cards.title: ‘Neighbours from Hell’ releases
cards.subtitle: Video game by JoWooD Entertainment
cards.fact: Neighbours from Hell is a puzzle strategy game developed and published by JoWood Productions.

cards.title: Lauren Bacall dies
cards.subtitle: American actress
cards.fact: Betty Joan Perske, known professionally as Lauren Bacall, was an American actress.
